title: Data Importer - public implementations survey
definition: Loads data from supported files, databases, and external services.
description:
Data Importer is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Loads data from supported files, databases, and external services. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Data Importer. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Data Importer. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Data Importer capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

title: Logstash - related Data Importer technology
definition: Elastic's log ingestion pipeline.
description:
Logstash is not itself a Data Importer, but it belongs in this survey because real Data Importer work leans on it. Elastic's log ingestion pipeline.

In a Data Importer build it shows up when the team already lives in its ecosystem. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Data Importer practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

For builders, Logstash is worth evaluating first as supporting technology. The demo program exercises a core idea from its domain - run it with node and watch each step.

description:
definition of done is the Data Importer discipline: Loads data from supported files, databases, and external services. It turns Data Importer from an event into a repeatable capability.

In practice this means: log every decision with its reason, so the next builder inherits understanding; verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes; keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it Teams that follow the discipline get predictable builds; teams that skip it get interesting stories. The Signature line prefers predictable builds, and this record's demo makes the discipline concrete and runnable.
